summary: No answer-key, tajweed or Qur'anic-text errors found in any of the 7 papers; Sifaat 1 (live HW 9) keys match the live migration 0047 and are correct (levels 4/3/1, غَاسِقٍ level 5, tap key in 86:1–4). Rā' keys (Q3, Q4, Q7, Q8, listen وَٱلْفَجْرِ heavy) and lām-of-Allah keys (tap 62:10–11, Q5, Q6 incl. قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ light) all check out; qalqala letter set ق ط ب ج د and both level keys (Q7, Q8, tap 96:1–8, listen 113:1) are right. All quoted Arabic matches tanzil (only a missing ḍamma in وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ). Totals, rubric sums and single-answer counts all validate. Systemic: after the 'back to WhatsApp' edit, the `why`/`status`, summaries and changes_v2 of the end tasks still describe in-app / Al-Ḥuṣarī reference recordings (6 of 7 papers); Sifaat 4's review notes also contradict each other on whether tap_letters is safe. Content suggestions: the subtle-qalqala definition omits word-final original sukoon, and the rā' Q5 rubric lacks the 'look one further back' stop case that Q9 tests.
